selection: Include every regular file recursively unless an explicit exclusion below applies. Historical failures, raw logs, exact commands, before/after inputs, selection and ignored-case ledgers, review provenance, screenshots and helper source are retained except the exact conservatively excluded paused-WIP patch.

exclude.reason: potential_url_userinfo: coordinator-approved conservative publication exclusion. Original cloud patch is untouched; ledger retains full-file SHA256, bytes, path and reason. Reviewable source commits remain in Git.
Generated Python bytecode cache; helper source remains included.
Generated Python bytecode; helper source remains included.
Retained native executable, not a test record. The associated retention proof stays included.
Redundant source payload archive/bundle. Paused-WIP manifests, source patch and frozen-input records stay included.
Never follow or archive symbolic links, devices, FIFOs, sockets or hard-link tar entries.
Compiled ELF/PE/Mach-O/archive/object metadata is a cache/artifact, not evidence source. Ledger retains path/hash/bytes; PNG screenshots are not excluded.

privacy.mode: Offline candidate detection only. Reports contain category/path/line/file SHA256, never matched values or surrounding text. Heuristics cannot prove absence of secrets, inspect pixels, or replace review of synthetic fixtures.
privacy.finalization: Final selected files must have zero detector candidates. A positive scan blocks packing even with a review attachment. Any conservative publication exclusion must be explicitly approved by the coordinator and recorded with original path/SHA256/bytes/reason; the cloud source is never edited or silently redacted.
privacy.screenshots: Selected local synthetic QA PNGs are included as requested. They are not proof of native Tauri, real-provider or user-data execution; pixel privacy requires the existing local visual review or a separate reviewer attestation.

consistency: Require the selected file set and identity/size/mtime/ctime to stay unchanged across capture. Re-read and hash every selected byte during archive construction, then check the source tree again. Active writers cause failure; incomplete output is removed.
claims: Packaging performs no application tests, provider calls, Git commits or pushes. Historical build/list records must never be relabeled runtime passes. Runtime claims remain solely in their original evidence records.
archiveSplitting: Prefer one archive under 20 MiB. If larger, split texts.tar.gz and screenshots.tar.gz. If a category still exceeds 20 MiB, split it into independently checksummed category-01/category-02 archives using conservative 18 MiB raw-byte chunks. Every selected source file is covered exactly once across the publication set.
